evidence.reason: render_units recursively enumerates every path under apps/crq-python/ops/systemd and filters by basename, but writes each rendered template to output / source.name. If the target tree contains two templates with the same basename in different subdirectories, the later atomic_bytes overwrites the earlier one, paths contains duplicate targets, and no error is raised, so one unit template is silently dropped. Rejecting duplicate basenames before writing is a routine correctness fix and preserves normal rendering for unique basenames.
